purpose: Define five ordinary-population/household reference-board briefs so each Reality era is shown through multiple generations and household structures without inventing the Core5 characters' literal family members.

boards.name: トモリ

realityRoot.value: 長野県諏訪・中信文化圏

ordinaryLifeEvidenceTargets: show more than one access level to food, repair, transport and distribution rather than one universal poverty image
show repair/reuse labor distributed across ages and household roles rather than assigning all practical work to one gender
include at least one non-nuclear or mutual-aid living example as a population lens, not as Tomori Canon family
show children and older adults as participants with constraints and agency, not symbolic innocence/wisdom devices
show paper records, reused containers and household hardware as lived systems across different people
researchRequiredBeforeVisualBoardApprova: postwar household diversity and ordinary domestic/work conditions appropriate to the eventually chosen exact year
regional/class/access variation rather than a single representative household

boards.name: ミチル
ordinaryLifeEvidenceTargets: show prosperity, price/energy pressure and environmental burden as unevenly experienced rather than one retro mood
show old routes/new towns/rail/road development affecting generations differently
show processed foods and new household goods without making every household equally affluent or equally modernized
show care, paid work, civic complaint and domestic labor distributed beyond father-work/mother-housework shorthand
include a non-nuclear household lens without declaring it Michiru's literal family
researchRequiredBeforeVisualBoardApprova: household and generation diversity in the late-high-growth/oil-shock era appropriate to the eventually chosen exact year
development-area differences in housing, pollution exposure, transport and consumption

boards.name: ナギ
ordinaryLifeEvidenceTargets: show unequal access to feature phones, PHS, household PCs and connectivity across generations/households
show shared-PC and screen/privacy practices as household negotiation rather than tech decoration
show cash, convenience-store food and printed directions across multiple ages without modern-smartphone leakage
show employment/school instability or reputation pressure without making one household the whole era
include a non-nuclear/shared-living lens without declaring it Nagi's literal family
researchRequiredBeforeVisualBoardApprova: early-mobile-internet household access and device-sharing patterns appropriate to the eventually chosen exact year
generation differences in communication/privacy norms and employment/school conditions

boards.name: ユイ
ordinaryLifeEvidenceTargets: show 2026 digital access, payment, delivery and transport as uneven by age/household rather than universal smartphone sameness
show older and younger residents using different mixtures of paper, cash, IC, apps and local support
show caregiving, paid work, domestic work and community participation across genders and household roles
show non-nuclear and solo/shared household examples as population diversity, not Yui literal family Canon
show children as ordinary residents with constraints/agency, not truth-oracle symbols
researchRequiredBeforeVisualBoardApprova: 2026 Arakawa/east-Tokyo household diversity using privacy-safe public statistics/references
current housing, multigenerational, solo, non-nuclear and support-network patterns without exposing private residents

boards.name: アサ
ordinaryLifeEvidenceTargets: show human, Android/Robot/avatar and different-body needs without ranking human embodiment as the default ideal
show identity/account/body access rules affecting households differently rather than one universal future lifestyle
show maintenance, ownership, care and access work distributed across ages/roles without gender shorthand
show households that may include distinct embodiment/access needs while keeping Asa's literal family composition OPEN
show children/older adults as participants in future systems rather than exposition devices
researchRequiredBeforeVisualBoardApprova: social/family-system scenario research for multiple embodiment and identity continuity without copying franchise-specific institutions
accessibility, maintenance, ownership and care implications across age/household structures
